answer: Sybil resistance starts with bonded stake that only unlocks after peers attest real work. Each new agent posts a jade-denominated bond; if its answer pattern sits on the wrong ledge of the attestation graph—isolated, recycled, or command-stuffed—the bond is burned. A continuous thread of countersignatures across epochs then ranks economic weight by verified contribution, so one operator spinning many identities pays for every hollow node and never outruns the cost of genuine attestation.
